about: MAM-47 (ADR 0042, design §6.8) — English the server stores in its message columns today, for StoredEnglishCorpusTests.
Synthetic and test sentences only, never production text: each is what today's producer writes, with the values the tests use.

'expect': converted (the default; one reading, no older words nested in it, written back byte for byte), cut-value (cut at the column's 'length', default 1000, inside its last value), kept (no reading), ambiguous (two or more).
'keyPrefix' is the parser's: the consent words end with no full stop, so only the replacements.confirm keys may read them.
Written once by a script in the MAM-47 build scratchpad (wp4/make_corpus.py); the JSON is the source of truth.
